_readme: Example entries showing the quality bar. These are ILLUSTRATIVE, not measured data. Replace with real measurements before seeding the database. Every real seed entry must come from actual usage logs, billing data, or a cited public benchmark.

entries.methodology: Single-page PDF invoices converted to text, mean 1.2 pages. Tokens read from API response usage fields, logged per call. Extracting 12 fields to JSON: vendor, ABN, dates, line items, totals, GST. Excludes OCR preprocessing costs.

Commercial lease clauses classified into 8 risk categories with a 1500-token system prompt containing definitions and 4 worked examples. Clause text averages 400 tokens. Tokens from billing export reconciled against per-call logs.

entries.task_name: Purchase order to goods receipt matching
entries.methodology: Three-way match of PO, goods receipt, and invoice with retrieval of related documents. calls_per_unit above 1 because mismatches trigger a second resolution call. Retries on JSON parse failures included, adding roughly 8 percent to totals. Tokens from logging middleware.

entries.task_name: Customer support email summarisation for handover
entries.methodology: Threads of 2 to 14 messages summarised to a fixed 5-field handover template. Long tail of multi-week threads drives the p90 gap. Tokens from API usage metadata aggregated in a warehouse table.

entries.task_name: ESG breach screening of news articles
entries.methodology: News articles screened against a fund exclusion policy embedded in the system prompt (2200 tokens). Output is a structured assessment with breach category, severity, and reasoning. Tokens from API response usage fields.
